# kalis: High Performance Li & Stephens Local Ancestry Inference

kalis (doi:
[10.1186/s12859-024-05688-8](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-024-05688-8))
provides a high performance implementation of the Li & Stephens model
(doi:
[10.1093/genetics/165.4.2213](https://doi.org/10.1093/genetics/165.4.2213))
for local ancestry inference (local referring to a region of the
genome). For a set of N phased haplotypes, kalis computes the posterior
marginal probability of each haplotype copying every other haplotype by
running N hidden Markov models in parallel. This yields an N x N matrix
that summarizes the recent local ancestry at each variant of interest.
The package provides functionality for specifying a recombination map,
site-specific mutation rates, and differing prior copying probabilities
for each recipient haplotype. Extensive use is made of low level
threading and CPU vector instructions.

## Installation

kalis will appear on CRAN in due course. For now, the current
development version can be installed using the
[remotes](https://github.com/r-lib/remotes) package as follows:

    install.packages("remotes")
    remotes::install_github("louisaslett/kalis", build_vignettes = TRUE)

Note that kalis uses various low-level optimisations meaning that you
should ensure the compiler is targeting your local CPU architecture. The
simplest way to do this is to pass configure variables setting the
correct `CFLAGS` at install time:

    remotes::install_github("louisaslett/kalis",
      configure.vars = c(kalis = "PKG_CFLAGS='-march=native -mtune=native -O3'"),
      build_vignettes = TRUE)

If you do not have the correct flags set, kalis will fall back to an
implementation which does not use the special vector instruction set
architecture of your CPU and will provide a warning when you load the
package in your R session.

## Citation

If you make use of this software, please cite the primary reference:

> Aslett L. J. M., Christ R. R. (2024). “kalis: a modern implementation
> of the Li & Stephens model for local ancestry inference in R.” *BMC
> Bioinformatics*, *25*(1), 1-18.
> [doi:10.1186/s12859-024-05688-8](https://doi.org/10.1186/s12859-024-05688-8%3E).

bibTeX:

    @Article{,
      title = {kalis: a modern implementation of the Li & Stephens model for local ancestry inference in R},
      author = {Aslett, L. J. M. and Christ, R. R.},
      journal = {BMC Bioinformatics},
      year = {2024},
      volume = {25},
      number = {1},
      pages = {1--18},
      doi = {10.1186/s12859-024-05688-8}
    }

Some additional functions were added after the above publication to
enable checkpointing and clade matrix construction, which are described
in:

> Christ, R.R., Wang, X., Aslett, L.J.M., Steinsaltz, D. and Hall, I.
> (2024) “Clade Distillation for Genome-wide Association Studies”,
> *bioRxiv 2024.09.30.615852*.
> [doi:10.1101/2024.09.30.615852](https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.09.30.615852).

bibTeX:

    @Article{,
      title = {Clade Distillation for Genome-wide Association Studies},
      author = {Christ, R. R. and Wang, X. and Aslett, L. J. M. and Steinsaltz, D. and Hall, I.},
      journal = {bioRxiv},
      year = {2024},
      number = {2024.09.30.615852},
      doi = {10.1101/2024.09.30.615852}
    }

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Backward()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/Backward.md) :
  Propagate a backward table

- [`CacheHaplotypes()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CacheHaplotypes.md)
  : Load haplotypes into optimised package cache

- [`CacheSummary()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CacheSummary.md)
  [`N()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CacheSummary.md)
  [`L()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CacheSummary.md) :
  Retrieve information about the haplotype cache

- [`CalcCheckpointTables()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CalcCheckpointTables.md)
  : Calculate Checkpoint Tables

- [`CalcRho()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CalcRho.md) :
  Calculate recombination probabilities

- [`CalcTraces()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CalcTraces.md)
  : Fast Calculation of Matrix Trace and Hilbert Schmidt Norm

- [`CladeMat()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CladeMat.md) :
  Fast clade matrix construction

- [`ClearHaplotypeCache()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/ClearHaplotypeCache.md)
  : Remove all cached haplotypes and free memory

- [`CopyTable()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CopyTable.md)
  : Copy Forward/Backward tables

- [`CreateForwardTableCache()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/CreateForwardTableCache.md)
  : Create cache for forward tables

- [`DistMat()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/DistMat.md) :
  Distance matrix

- [`FillTableCache()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/FillTableCache.md)
  : Fill a forward table cache

- [`Forward()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/Forward.md) :
  Propagate a forward table

- [`ForwardIterator()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/ForwardIterator.md)
  : Build an efficient iterator over loci

- [`ForwardUsingTableCache()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/ForwardUsingTableCache.md)
  : Use a forward table cache to propagate

- [`MakeBackwardTable()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/MakeBackwardTable.md)
  :

  Create a `kalisBackwardTable`

- [`MakeForwardTable()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/MakeForwardTable.md)
  :

  Create a `kalisForwardTable`

- [`Parameters()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/Parameters.md)
  : Define a set of Li and Stephens parameters

- [`PostProbs()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/PostProbs.md)
  : Posterior marginal probabilities

- [`PruneCladeMat()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/PruneCladeMat.md)
  : Prune called sprigs or singletons from inferred clade matrix

- [`QueryCache()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/QueryCache.md)
  : Retrieve haplotypes from memory cache

- [`ResetTable()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/ResetTable.md)
  : Reset Forward/Backward tables

- [`SmallHaps`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/SmallHaps.md)
  [`SmallMap`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/SmallHaps.md) :
  Small example phased haplotype dataset and recombination map

- [`Sprigs()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/Sprigs.md) :
  Greedy sprig calling based on nearest neighbourhoods

- [`WriteHaplotypes()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/WriteHaplotypes.md)
  [`ReadHaplotypes()`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/WriteHaplotypes.md)
  : I/O for haplotype matrices in HDF5 files

- [`plot(`*`<kalisDistanceMatrix>`*`)`](https://kalis.louisaslett.com/reference/plot.kalisDistanceMatrix.md)
  : Plotting function for a distance matrix
